# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9
## Reflection
Every morning you wake up, a battle line is drawn. Not against flesh and blood, but against apathy, distraction, and the pull of comfort. Joshua stood at the edge of the Promised Land facing giants, walled cities, and his own fear—and God didn't tell him to feel brave. He commanded him to *be* strong and courageous. Courage is not the absence of fear; it's obedience in the presence of it.

Men, your strength was never meant to be self-manufactured. The command comes with a promise: "the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." You don't battle the day alone. That meeting you're dreading, that temptation you're fighting, that conversation you've been avoiding—you walk into it with God at your side. Strength is a decision before it's a feeling. So get up, set your face like flint, and step into today like a man who knows who stands with him.
## Daily Challenge
Before your first task today, do 20 pushups and pray, "Lord, I will be strong and courageous—You are with me." Then attack the hardest thing on your list first.
